# Blessed Sacrament Church — Queenstown (port of www.bsc.org.sg)
# The site is a HashRouter SPA: canonical content lives at /#/path URLs and
# the canonical domain is https://www.bsc.org.sg/ (see index.html <link rel=canonical>).
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow:

# No sitemap.xml: hash-style routes are not individually indexable; crawlers
# should index the canonical parish domain (bsc.org.sg). Unknown paths on
# static hosts return the SPA shell with HTTP 200 (soft 404) — accepted
# trade-off of HashRouter on static hosting (ADR-1).
